topic: Refactoring profile ID for data retrieval
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the technical approach to switching company profiles and retrieving user data. It was decided that relying on `profileId` is preferable, as it offers flexibility by allowing multiple parameters (company, profile, user) to be available.

To implement this, a new view (`вьюха`) will be created in the database. The schema change involves updating the join logic: replacing joins on `user` and `userId` with joins on `user_profile` and using `profileId`. It was agreed that keeping `profileId` as an integer type is best practice to maintain clarity between `userId` and `profileId`.

Regarding implementation scope, it was suggested to start by integrating the new logic into a few key pages before rolling out to all remaining areas.
decisions: Adopt using `profileId` as the primary identifier for data retrieval.
Create a new database view to handle the updated join logic.
Keep `profileId` as an integer type (intov) for clarity.
action_items: [p1] will attempt implementation and follow up on the task.
